title: WorkspaceBindingProposal
description:
Transient proposal for an edge surface to ask the daemon to bind a candidate folder to an already-registered project.

This is not a durable state and not accepted evidence. See the module docs for the authority boundary.

candidate_path.description: **LOCAL-ONLY.** Absolute candidate folder path for daemon/MCP local use. MUST NOT cross the hosted bridge or appear in any hosted-safe view.

confidence.description: Surface confidence that the candidate is correct, in `[0.0, 1.0]`.

display.description: Redacted display metadata safe for hosted-bridge exposure.

project_id.description: Opaque, already-registered project identifier the binding targets. Never a filesystem path (see [`ProjectRegistration`] semantics in the registration spec).

reason.description: Human-readable reason the surface is proposing this candidate.

source_surface.description: Which local surface authored this proposal (`mcp` in alpha).

ProjectSafeDisplayMetadata.description:
Redacted, project-safe display metadata for a binding proposal.

SAFE to cross the hosted bridge: contains no local filesystem path, provider secret, source body, or event-store body. Any folder hint here must be a non-path label (e.g. a basename), never an absolute path.

candidate_label.description: Optional non-path folder label to help a human recognize the candidate (e.g. the folder basename only). MUST NOT be an absolute path.

display_name.description: Human-readable project display name. No path/remote/secret leakage.

project_slug.description: Optional short project slug/label. Safe, opaque display token.

WorkspaceBindingSourceSurface.description:
Local surface that authored a [`WorkspaceBindingProposal`].

In alpha, MCP is the proposing surface (`source_surface: mcp`). Other local surfaces are listed for forward-compatibility; none grant authority — the daemon still validates and materializes the binding.

oneOf.description: MCP thin-client session proposed the binding.
Local CLI invocation proposed the binding.
Local review dashboard/TUI proposed the binding.
